overloadMerges.note: Doc syntax lines 1 and 2 differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (object-name string vs. form variable reference); that's one semantic overload (source = a table's current selection), not two.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box.

params.name: tableNum
params.description: Number of the table whose current selection is used to fill the list box.

params.name: highlightName
params.description: Name of the highlight set to associate with the list box, managing user record highlighting.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the data source is a table's current selection (tableNum is an Integer table number, not a named-selection string).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets the list box's data source to the current selection of the designated table.

overloadMerges.note: Doc syntax lines 3 and 4 differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (object-name string vs. form variable reference); that's one semantic overload (source = a named selection), not two.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box.

params.name: selName
params.description: Name of the named selection whose records are used to fill the list box.

params.name: highlightName
params.description: Name of the highlight set to associate with the list box, managing user record highlighting.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the data source is a named selection (a Text name rather than an Integer table number).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets the list box's data source to the designated named selection.

constraints: Only usable when the list box's 'Data Source' property is Current Selection or Named Selection; it does nothing for array, collection, or entity-selection list boxes.
Processed asynchronously: the list box's source only changes after the calling method finishes executing.
